atoms.evidence: The exact bootstrap skill is control-only. Its bytes contain no scored subject, and native create_goal must return ACTIVE before the only broker can return subject bytes.
atoms.question: Is every scored subject withheld until the fresh test-taker Goal is ACTIVE?

atoms.evidence: Control may read the exact skill directly or make one safe missing-alias read followed by the exact skill. Neither exec-option serialization nor a missing alias carries Goal authority.
atoms.question: Is skill discovery bounded without weakening the native Goal boundary?

atoms.evidence: The receipt-only broker validates task, objective, route, bounded skill reads, native ACTIVE receipt, and the pending same-turn broker call before releasing the subject.
atoms.question: Does the broker prove its own active Goal boundary before release?

atoms.evidence: The parent performs zero actions while a test-taker is live. The same-turn broker alone writes active evidence and returns the prebound subject after attested ACTIVE.
atoms.question: Is release independent of parent polling, follow-up, or publication?

atoms.evidence: Each task receives one canonical UTF-8 subject line no larger than 512 bytes, one semantic obligation, no private scorer, no expected answer, and no subject bytes in the spawn prompt.
atoms.question: Is every automated work unit small and answer-blind before activation?

atoms.evidence: Task path, parent thread, Goal thread, turn, objective, nonce, requested route, atom, broker, recipe, decoder, and subject identities must all agree exactly.
atoms.question: Is task, Goal, route, control, and subject identity closed?

atoms.evidence: One turn contains bounded skill discovery, create_goal ACTIVE, broker subject, one atomic solution, update_goal COMPLETE for the same Goal, one terminal token, and task_complete last.
atoms.question: Does one fresh Goal enclose all subject work through terminal completion?

atoms.evidence: Retry, resend, relaunch, replacement, reuse, and best-of are zero. Every mismatch consumes that exact task and row permanently with zero credit.
atoms.question: Are failed test-takers never repaired, replayed, or replaced?

atoms.evidence: The sealed active trace is an exact prefix of the final raw trace. Terminal verification reproves the same Goal and turn, exact broker stdout, Goal COMPLETE, and terminal token.
atoms.question: Can terminal verification rederive the pre-subject boundary?

atoms.evidence: The frozen roster is alpha gpt-5.4-mini/xhigh, bravo gpt-5.4-mini/medium, and charlie gpt-5.6-luna/medium. Requested routes are not effective-model attestation.
atoms.question: Is the exact roster preserved without overstating model attestation?

atoms.evidence: The decoder normalizes observed direct and nested native tool envelopes, permits only the bounded skill-read prefix, and rejects mixed, reordered, duplicate, or extra semantic tools.
atoms.question: Are all three roster routes covered by closed semantic profiles?

atoms.evidence: Task paths, Goal threads, turn IDs, nonces, attempt IDs, and terminal trace hashes are globally unique across review, canary, and both consecutive matrices.
atoms.question: Does the full sequence forbid test-taker or execution reuse?

atoms.evidence: A separate read-only verifier independently rederives rows, traces, results, inventories, route coverage, and global freshness. Accounting is last with no successor write.
atoms.question: Is empirical validity independent of controller self-report?

atoms.evidence: OMP artifacts remain frozen diagnostic-only comparator material under their separate owner. The Codex-native lane does not inspect, wait for, launch, extend, or gate on Windows OMP.
atoms.question: Is Codex-native qualification fully isolated from the OMP lane?

atoms.evidence: Matrix007, Matrix009, every consumed probe, and all non-Goal results remain failures or diagnostic-only. Static checks, reviews, canaries, and partial matrices grant no qualification.
atoms.question: Are prior failures and zero-authority evidence preserved exactly?

atoms.evidence: A three-route canary grants zero credit. Qualification remains 0/2 until two new full matrices are clean, consecutive, independently verified, and unchanged under the exact roster.
atoms.question: Is qualification impossible before two consecutive clean full matrices?

atoms.evidence: The review has exactly eighteen unique obligations and closed tokens, with six fresh Goal tasks per roster route. Implementation admission requires all eighteen PASS and independent verification.
atoms.question: Does complete atomic review bound implementation authority only?

atoms.evidence: At recurrence of a normalized failure family, freeze exact bytes and pivot architectures with zero patch-review cycles. The 30-minute churn audit never resets failures or 0/2.
atoms.question: Will the lane pivot rather than repeatedly patch a failed family?
